name: Kamome Saaya
source:
The mysterious elegant yet cute girl who barely talks and has a sharp gaze—these are basically the words people use to describe her… in their minds. Because of her sharp gaze, people often mistook her for being angry. She often got into problems because of that, mainly with upperclassmen. She dreams of becoming a great musician just like her mother once was, and she actually has the passion and talent for it. However, as the result of one fateful night when she was kidnapped, she was about to throw away that dream and almost hate herself for it. 

[Taken from [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/63024782/la-memoire-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
